summary: Final client readout for Avernelwick Pharmaceuticals Ltd covering hERG (IKr) safety pharmacology and the CYP safety interaction panel. Favourable cardiac profile retained, with a CYP-sensitive subseries; alternatives selected for follow-up.

slides.title: Client decision
bullets: {{PRJ0013:n_compounds}} test articles evaluated in the non-GLP in vitro investigation.
Favourable cardiac profile retained, with a CYP-sensitive subseries; alternatives selected for follow-up.
Screening ranks test articles; it does not establish clinical safety or a GLP conclusion.
slides.notes: v3 client copy: alternatives selected replaces earlier recommendation to consider alternatives; results unchanged.

slides.title: Scope and control validity
bullets: E-4031 IC50 {{PRJ0013:herg.control_e4031_nM}} nM; acceptance interval 5–50 nM.
CYP control IC50s assessed against 0.5–2 times historical means.
No live-animal procedures were included; animal welfare oversight of the regulated portfolio is separate.

slides.title: Cardiac distribution and qualifications
bullets: {{PRJ0013:herg.n_lt_1uM}} below 1 µM; {{PRJ0013:herg.n_1_10uM}} between 1 and 10 µM; {{PRJ0013:herg.n_ge_10uM}} at or above 10 µM.
Median IC50 {{PRJ0013:herg.median_ic50_uM}} µM; top concentration {{PRJ0013:herg.top_conc_uM}} µM.
{{PRJ0013:herg.n_censored}} censored estimates and {{PRJ0013:herg.n_flagged}} flagged entries require their observation-sheet qualifications.
Censored estimates are bounds, not fitted potencies; finite estimates require an exposure comparison.

slides.title: CYP-sensitive test articles
bullets: {{PRJ0013:cyp.n_any_gt50}} test articles exceeded 50% inhibition on at least one isoform.
CYP3A4 was most frequently flagged. Counts overlap and must not be summed.
The single-concentration panel does not establish inhibition mechanism.

slides.title: CYP panel extract: compare the full fingerprint
Handover and next decision
bullets: Prioritize the selected branch or alternatives using both cardiac potency and CYP fingerprints.
Resolve flagged hERG entries before relying on rank; obtain concentration responses for CYP liabilities in proposed leads.
Compare assay potency with projected unbound exposure before progression.
Full tables and control documentation: OT-23-S0046_RPT_A_signed.pdf.
